examples.text: dasa pañhā das'uddesā dasa veyyākaraṇānī'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
rājāno nāma pathabyārājā padesarājā maṇḍalikā antarabhogikā akkhadassā mah'āmattā, ye vā pana chejjabhejjaṃ karontā anusāsanti. ete rājāno nāma.

32103.commentary: (THIa) yattakaṃ tulitā esā'ti tuyhaṃ dhītā anopamā yattakaṃ dhanaṃ agghatī'ti tulitā lakkhaṇaññūhi paricchinnā, tato aṭṭhaguṇaṃ dassāmī'ti pitu me pesayi dūtan'ti yojanā.

examples.text: yattakaṃ tulitā esā, tuyhaṃ dhītā anopamā, tato aṭṭhaguṇaṃ dassaṃ, hiraññaṃ ratanāni ca.
sace pana te, puṇṇa, sunāparantakā manussā pāṇinā pahāraṃ dassanti, tatra pana te, puṇṇa, kin'ti bhavissatī'ti?

32104.meaning1: will cause; will; let; will allow (to happen)

examples.text: n'āhaṃ taṃ pamāṇaṃ atikkamitvā rajjan'ādi-vasena uppajjituṃ dassāmī'ti evam'ettha attho daṭṭhabbo.

32105.meaning1: hypothetical present tense of many nouns and verbs; in reality passati or dakkhati
32105.meaning2: hypothetical present tense of many nouns and verbs; in reality passati or dakkhati

examples.text: mā piyehi samāgañchi, appiyehi kudācanaṃ, piyānaṃ adassanaṃ dukkhaṃ, appiyānañ'ca dassanaṃ.
tena kho pana, bhikkhu, samayena tādiso'v'assa kiṃsuko yathā'pi tassa purisassa dassanaṃ.
naccagītavāditavisūkadassanā paṭivirato hoti mālā-gandha-vilepana-dhāraṇa-maṇḍana-vibhūsana-ṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti
khantī ca sovacassatā, samaṇānañ'ca dassanaṃ, kālena dhammasākacchā, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
es'eva maggo n'atth'añño, dassanassa visuddhiyā, etañ'hi tumhe paṭipajjatha, mārass'etaṃ pamohanaṃ.
diṭṭhiñ'ca anupaggamma, sīlavā dassanena sampanno, kāmesu vineyya gedhaṃ, na hi jātu gabbhaseyya punaretī'ti.

32109.synonym: akkha, akkhi, cakkhu, nayana, netta, locana

examples.text: api dūragatā saramhase, āyatapamhe visuddhadassane, na hi m'atthi tayā piyattarā, nayanā kinnarimandalocane.

32111.meaning1: wishing to see; wanting to visit
32111.commentary: (ANa) dassanakāmo sīlavatan'ti dasa'pi yojanāni vīsam'pi tiṃsam'pi yojanasatam'pi gantvā sīlasampanne daṭṭhu'kāmo hoti pāṭaliputtakabrāhmaṇo viya saddhātissamahārājā viya ca.

examples.text: kahaṃ nu kho, bhante, eta'r'ahi bhagavā viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho? dassanakām'amhā mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan'ti.
bhavam'atthu bhavantaṃ jotipālaṃ, rājā disampati bhavantaṃ jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantayati, rājā disampati bhoto jotipālassa māṇavassa dassanakāmo'ti

32112.meaning1: wishing to see more; wanting to see even more (of)

32113.meaning1: we wish to see; we want to meet
32113.commentary: (UDa) dassanakām'amhā'ti daṭṭhu'kāmā amha. mayañ'hi taṃ bhagavantaṃ andho viya cakkhuṃ, badhiro viya sotaṃ, mūgo viya kalyāṇavākkaraṇaṃ, hatthapādavikalo viya hatthapāde, daliddo viya dhanasampadaṃ, kantāraddhānappaṭipanno viya khem'antabhūmiṃ, rogābhibhūto viya ārogyaṃ, mahāsamudde bhinnanāvo viya mahākullaṃ passituṃ upasaṅkamituñ'ca icchāmā'ti dasseti.

examples.text: kahaṃ nu kho, bhante, eta'r'ahi bhagavā viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho? dassanakām'amhā mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan'ti.

32116.meaning1: rooted in realization; founded on understanding

examples.text: yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi byañjanehi tathāgate saddhā niviṭṭhā hoti mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ākāravatī saddhā dassanamūlikā

32117.meaning1: suitable to see; desirable to see
32117.commentary: (ANt) dassanayuttā'ti surūpabhāvena passitabbayuttā, dissamānā cakkhūni piyāyatī'ti aññakiccavikkhepaṃ hitvāpi daṭṭhabbā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

32118.commentary: (DNa) ayaṃ paṭhamā dassanasamāpattī'ti ayaṃ dvattiṃ sākāraṃ paṭikūlato manasikatvā paṭikūladassanavasena uppāditā paṭhamajjhānasamāpatti paṭhamā dassanasamāpatti nāma, sace pana taṃ jhānaṃ pādakaṃ katvā sot'āpanno hoti, ayaṃ nippariyāyen'eva paṭhamā dassanasamāpatti.

examples.text: atikkamma ca purisassa chavimaṃsalohitaṃ aṭṭhiṃ paccavekkhati. ayaṃ dutiyā dassanasamāpatti.

32120.meaning1: endowed with insight; who has vision; wise; epithet of a stream-enterer

examples.text: ete parābhave loke, paṇḍito samavekkhiya, ariyo dassanasampanno, sa lokaṃ bhajate sivan'ti.

32122.meaning1: by means of insight; through realization
32122.commentary: (MNa) dassanā pahātabbā'ti dassanena pahātabbā. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, āsavā dassanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā saṃvarā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā paṭisevanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā adhivāsanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā parivajjanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā vinodanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā bhāvanā pahātabbā.

32123.meaning1: following the view; conforming to an opinion
32123.commentary: (MNt) diṭṭh'ānugatin'ti diṭṭhiyā anugamanan'ti dassento dassan'ānugatin'ti vatvā sikkhāttayasaṅgahaṃ bhagavato sāsanaṃ tena diṭṭhattā diṭṭhi, tassa tass'eva khamanavasena khanti, ruccanavasena ruci, taṃdiṭṭhikhantirucikāva bhagavato sāvakā'ti āha yaṃdiṭṭhiko'tiādi.

32125.meaning1: excellency of vision; best kind of insight
32125.commentary: (MNa) dassan'ānuttariyan'ti lokiyalok'uttarā paññā… suddhalok'uttaram'eva vā gahetvā dassan'ānuttariyan'ti arahattamaggasammādiṭṭhi… khīṇ'āsavassa vā nibbānadassanaṃ dassan'ānuttariyaṃ nāma.

examples.text: evaṃ vimuttacitto kho, aggivessana, bhikkhu tīhi anuttariyehi samannāgato hoti, dassan'ānuttariyena, paṭipad'ānuttariyena, vimutt'ānuttariyena.

32126.grammar: nt, dat sg of dassana (+acc or +dat)

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena m'idh'ekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya, daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā app'esakkhā ca?
yo pana bhikkhu uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gaccheyya aññatra tathārūpappaccayā, pācittiyaṃ.

32127.grammar: nt, dat sg of dassana (+acc or +dat)
32127.meaning1: in order to visit; for the purpose of seeing

examples.text: na arahati bhavaṃ kūṭadanto samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ. samaṇo tv'eva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ kūṭadantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
yathārūpaṃ parisaṃ alaṃ yojanagaṇanāni'pi dassanāya gantuṃ api puṭ'aṃsenā'pi, tathārūpo ayaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhusaṅgho.
cattār'imāni, ānanda, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyāni saṃvejanīyāni ṭhānāni

32129.meaning1: beautiful to behold; lovely to look at; handsome

examples.text: apissu taṃ jano disvā evam'āha, abhirūpo vata, bho, rañño nāgo, dassanīyo vata, bho, rañño nāgo, pāsādiko vata, bho, rañño nāgo, kāy'upapanno vata, bho, rañño nāgo'ti!
ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena m'idh'ekacco mātugāmo abhirūpā ca hoti dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā, daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā app'esakkhā ca?

32130.meaning1: more beautiful to behold; lovelier to look at

examples.text: yathā yathā kho, assalāyana, satta brāhmaṇ'isayo asitaṃ devalaṃ isiṃ abhisapiṃsu tathā tathā asito devalo isi abhirūpataro c'eva hoti dassanīyataro ca pāsādikataro ca.

32131.meaning1: arising of insight; epithet of stream entry

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, yato ariyasāvakassa virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ uppajjati, saha dassan'uppādā, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa tīṇi saṃyojanāni pahīyanti, sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso.

32132.meaning1: field of vision; range of sight
32132.commentary: (VINa) dassan'ūpacāraṃ vā savan'ūpacāraṃ vā vijahantassā'ti ettha yadi ṭhito vā nisinno vā uyyojeti. yo uyyojito, so vijahati, tassa ca āpatti nāma n'atthi.

examples.text: uyyojeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. dassan'ūpacāraṃ vā savan'ūpacāraṃ vā vijahantassa āpatti dukkaṭassa. vijahite, āpatti pācittiyassa.
yattha ṭhito passati, āpatti pācittiyassa. dassan'ūpacāraṃ vijahitvā punappunaṃ passati, āpatti pācittiyassa.

32133.meaning2: good-looking; fair to behold; beautiful; handsome

examples.text: sabbattha ve sappurisā cajanti, na kāmakāmā lapayanti santo, sukhena phuṭṭhā atha vā dukhena, na ucc'āvacaṃ paṇḍitā dassayanti.
patilīnacarassa bhikkhuno, bhajamānassa vivittam'āsanaṃ, sāmaggiyam'āhu tassa taṃ, yo attānaṃ bhavane na dassaye.
nanu dubbhissasi maṃ punappunaṃ, muhuṃ muhuṃ cāraṇikaṃ'va dassayaṃ, ummattaken'eva mayā palobhasi, kiñ'c'āpi te citta virādhitaṃ mayā.
patilīnacarassa bhikkhuno, bhajamānassa vivittam'āsanaṃ, sāmaggiyam'āhu tassa taṃ, yo attānaṃ bhavane na dassaye.

32138.grammar: fut, reflx 1st sg of dassati, trans (+acc)
32138.commentary: (THIa) yattakaṃ tulitā esā'ti tuyhaṃ dhītā anopamā yattakaṃ dhanaṃ agghatī'ti tulitā lakkhaṇaññūhi paricchinnā, tato aṭṭhaguṇaṃ dassāmī'ti pitu me pesayi dūtan'ti yojanā.

examples.text: yattakaṃ tulitā esā, tuyhaṃ dhītā anopamā, tato aṭṭhaguṇaṃ dassaṃ, hiraññaṃ ratanāni ca.

32140.meaning1: having shown; having exhibited; having presented

examples.text: veṭhitasīso nāma kes'antaṃ na dassāpetvā veṭhito hoti.
evaṃ abhikkantadassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kathaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ, maccurājā na passati.
anejaṃ mūladassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kiṃ nissitā isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, purisassa kiṃsuko adiṭṭhapubbo assa. so yen'aññataro puriso kiṃsukassa dassāvī ten'upasaṅkameyya.
idha, gahapati, sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati

manussā, ayyena kira pilindavacchena sarājikāya parisāya uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassitan'ti, attamanā abhippasannā āyasmato pilindavacchassa pañca bhesajjāni abhihariṃsu, seyyath'idaṃ, sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ.

32145.meaning1: displayed text; shown text; presented text

examples.text: imissā ca, bhikkhave, mahāpathaviyā pahūtarattaratanāya [pahūtasattaratanāya tikanipāte mahāvagge dasamasuttaṭīkāyaṃ dassitapāḷiyā sameti] mātāpitaro issar'ādhipacce rajje patiṭṭhāpeyya, na tv'eva, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ kataṃ vā hoti paṭikataṃ vā.

32146.meaning1: exhibited one's craft; shown off one's skill
32146.commentary: (MNt) kataṃ rājakul'ādīsu upecca asanaṃ etena so kat'ūpāsano'ti āha rājakul'ādīsu dassitasippo'ti.

examples.text: katahattho na hoti, ayaṃ pana katahattho ciṇṇavasībhāvo. kat'ūpāsano'ti rājakul'ādīsu dassitasippo. lahukena asanenā'ti anto susiraṃ katvā tūlādīni pūretvā kata-lākhā-parikammena sallahukakaṇḍena.

32148.synonym: jāna, ñū, dasa, dassāvī, vijāna, vidū
32148.commentary: (NIDD1) kathaṃdassī'ti kīdisena dassanena samannāgato, kiṃsaṇṭhitena, kiṃpakārena, kiṃpaṭibhāgenā'ti, kathaṃdassī.

examples.text: kathaṃdassī kathaṃsīlo, upasanto'ti vuccati, taṃ me gotama pabrūhi, pucchito uttamaṃ naraṃ.
kiṃ me ekena tiṇṇena, purisena thāmadassinā, sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇitvā, santāressaṃ sadevakaṃ.

32149.meaning1: who sees; who knows; who perceives; who understands

examples.text: sa sabbadhammesu visenibhūto, yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, tam'eva dassiṃ vivaṭaṃ carantaṃ, ken'īdha lokasmi vikappayeyya.
sokapparidevamaccharaṃ, na jahanti giddhā mamāyite, tasmā munayo pariggahaṃ, hitvā acariṃsu khemadassino.

32151.commentary: (DNa) dassukhīlan'ti corakhīlaṃ. (DNt) dassavo eva khīlasadisattā dassukhīlaṃ. yathā hi khette khīlaṃ kasan'ādīnaṃ sukhappavattiṃ, mūlasantānena sassassa buddhiñ'ca vibandhati, evaṃ dassavo rajje rāj'āṇāya sukhappavattiṃ, mūlaviruḷhiyā janapadānaṃ paribuddhiñ'ca vibandhanti. tena vuttaṃ dassavo eva khīlasadisattā dassukhīlan'ti.

examples.text: aham'etaṃ dassukhīlaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā pabbājanāya vā samūhanissāmī'ti

32152.meaning1: brigandage; plague of robbery; crime wave

examples.text: siyā kho pana bhoto rañño evam'assa, aham'etaṃ dassukhīlaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā pabbājanāya vā samūhanissāmī'ti, na kho panetassa dassukhīlassa evaṃ sammā samugghāto hoti.

32154.meaning1: guide; who shows; who points out

examples.text: brahmā'ti, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ… taṃ kissa hetu? bahukārā, bhikkhave, mātāpitaro, puttānaṃ āpādakā posakā imassa lokassa dassetāro'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā rañño dasseyyuṃ, ayaṃ te, deva, coro āgucārī, imassa yaṃ icchasi taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehī'ti
maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyyā'ti jīvite ādīnavaṃ dasseti, maraṇe vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇati.

32156.meaning1: to show off; to exhibit; to present

examples.text: so vesāliyaṃ parisati evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, samaṇo'pi gotamo ñāṇavādo, aham'pi ñāṇavādo. ñāṇavādo kho pana ñāṇavādena arahati uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassetuṃ.
sappaṭibhayaṃ nāma tasmiṃ magge corehi manussā hatā dissanti, viluttā dissanti, ākoṭitā dissanti, sappaṭibhayaṃ gantvā appaṭibhayaṃ dassetvā uyyojetabbā, gacchatha bhaginiyo'ti.
imasmiṃ vitakkamūlabhedapabbe ṭhatvā vitakke niggaṇhituṃ asakkontena pana evaṃ niggaṇhitabbā'ti aparam'pi kāraṇaṃ dassento puna tassa ce, bhikkhave'ti-ādim'āha.
attano sāmike kāsāvadhare muṇḍakasīse disvā cittaṃ ek'aggaṃ na bhaveyya, tena maggaphalāni pattuṃ na sakkuṇeyyuṃ. tasmā acalasaddhāya patiṭṭhitakāle tāsaṃ te bhikkhū arahattappatte'y'eva dassesi
atha kho jīvako komārabhacco seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ mañcake nipātetvā sambandhitvā sīsacchaviṃ uppāṭetvā sibbiniṃ vināmetvā dve pāṇake nīharitvā mahājanassa dassesi.
bhojane mattaññuno bhavissāma, paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma, n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya
kathañ'hi nāma bhikkhu saṅghaṃ ārabbha davaṃ karissatī'ti
app'eva nām'etaṃ māluvābījaṃ moro vā gileyya, mago vā khādeyya, davaḍāho vā ḍaheyya, vanakammikā vā uddhareyyuṃ, upacikā vā uṭṭhaheyyuṃ, abījaṃ vā pan'assā'ti.
app'eva nām'etaṃ māluvābījaṃ moro vā gileyya, mago vā khādeyya, davaḍāho vā ḍaheyya, vanakammikā vā uddhareyyuṃ, upacikā vā uṭṭhaheyyuṃ, abījaṃ vā pan'assā'ti.

32166.meaning1: wish to joke; desire to have fun
32166.commentary: (KVt) davakamyatā nāma keḷihas'ādhippāyatā. (VBt) davakamyatā nāma keḷi, taṃ dassetuṃ has'ādhippāyatā'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: upasampanno upasampannaṃ na khuṃsetu'kāmo na vambhetu'kāmo na maṅkukattu'kāmo, davakamyatā hīnena hīnaṃ vadeti, caṇḍālaṃ venaṃ nesādaṃ rathakāraṃ pukkusaṃ, caṇḍālo'si, veno'si, nesādo'si, rathakāro'si, pukkuso'sī'ti bhaṇati, āpatti vācāya, vācāya dubbhāsitassa.

32167.notes:
possible dayaḍāha
PED suggests dava from √du dunoti 'to burn'

examples.text: app'eva nām'etaṃ māluvābījaṃ moro vā gileyya, mago vā khādeyya, davaḍāho vā ḍaheyya, vanakammikā vā uddhareyyuṃ, upacikā vā uṭṭhaheyyuṃ, abījaṃ vā pan'assā'ti.

32171.meaning1: (of a horse) going long distances; (comm) charging
32171.commentary: (MNa) davatte'ti davattāya, yuddhakālasmiñ'hi hatthīsu vā koñcanādaṃ karontesu assesu vā hasantesu rathesu vā nighosantesu yodhesu vā ukkuṭṭhiṃ karontesu tassa ravassa abhāyitvā parasenapavesan'atthaṃ ayaṃ kāraṇā karīyati.

examples.text: yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti anukkame maṇḍale khurakāse dhāve davatte rājaguṇe rājavaṃse uttame jave uttame haye uttame sākhalye.

32172.commentary: (ANa) na dav'atthā'ti na kīḷan'atthā. na rat'atthā'ti na kāmarati-atthā.

examples.text: tassa sā hoti brāhmaṇī n'eva kām'atthā na dav'atthā na rat'atthā, paj'atthā'va brāhmaṇassa brāhmaṇī hoti.

32173.meaningLit: for the sake of a fun

examples.text: yaññ'atthāya moceti, sagg'atthāya moceti, bīj'atthāya moceti, vīmaṃs'atthāya moceti, dav'atthāya moceti, nīlaṃ moceti, pītakaṃ moceti, lohitakaṃ moceti, odātaṃ moceti

32174.meaning1: makes a joke (about); has fun; mocks

examples.text: kathañ'hi nāma bhikkhu saṅghaṃ ārabbha davaṃ karissatī'ti

32175.meaning1: for fun; for play; for sport
32175.commentary: (VISM) n'eva davāyā'ti na gāmadārak'ādayo viya davatthaṃ, kīḷānimittan'ti vuttaṃ hoti

examples.text: aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgataṃ kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo āhāraṃ āhāreti, n'eva davāya, na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya
bhojane mattaññuno bhavissāma paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya

32176.commentary: (MNa) devadahaṃ nāmā'ti devā vuccanti rājāno, tattha ca sakyarājūnaṃ maṅgalapokkharaṇī ahosi pāsādikā ārakkhasampannā, sā devānaṃ dahattā devadahan'ti paññāyittha. tadupādāya so'pi nigamo devadahan'tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gato. bhagavā taṃ nigamaṃ nissāya lumbinivane viharati.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati devadahaṃ nāma sakyānaṃ nigamo.
gāme araññe sukhadukkhaphuṭṭho, n'ev'attato no parato dahetha, phusanti phassā upadhiṃ paṭicca, nirūpadhiṃ kena phuseyyu phassā'ti.
te vādakāmā parisaṃ vigayha, bālaṃ dahantī mithu aññam'aññaṃ, vadanti te aññasitā kath'ojjaṃ, pasaṃsakāmā kusalā vadānā.
so tesaṃ bhogānaṃ ārakkh'ādhikaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, kin'ti me bhoge n'eva rājāno hareyyuṃ, na corā hareyyuṃ, na aggi daheyya, na udakaṃ vaheyya, na appiyā dāy'ādā hareyyun'ti

seyyathā'pi, rāhula, tejo sucim'pi dahati, asucim'pi dahati, gūthagatam'pi dahati, muttagatam'pi dahati, kheḷagatam'pi dahati, pubbagatam'pi dahati, lohitagatam'pi dahati, na ca tena tejo aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā
ayaṃ samaṇo nisinnako'va kālaṅ'kato! handa naṃ dahāmā'ti.
yo have daharo bhikkhu, yuñjati buddhasāsane, so'maṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti, abbhā mutto'va candimā.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu daharo hoti yuvā susu kāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo samayo padhānāya.
evam'eva manussesu, daharo ce'pi paññavā, so hi tattha mahā hoti, n'eva bālo sarīravā'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko ādāse vā parisuddhe pariyodāte acche vā udakapatte sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno

so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, aparena samayena daharo'va samāno, susukāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā, akāmakānaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ, kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.
daharakālato paṭṭhāya hi naṃ mārāpento'va seṭṭhi māretuṃ n'āsakkhi, kiṃ akkharasamayaṃ sikkhāpessati?
brāhmaṇatissabhaye pana bhātaragāmavāsino nāgattheriyā anārocetvā'va palāyiṃsu. therī paccūsasamaye ativiya appanigghoso gāmo, upadhāretha tāvā'ti daharabhikkhuniyo āha.

32192.commentary: (ANa) daharabhūmī'ti yena kāraṇena daharo nāma hoti, taṃ kāraṇaṃ.

examples.text: atthi, brāhmaṇa, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena vuddhabhūmi ca akkhātā daharabhūmi ca.

32193.meaning1: suitable for a young boy, an old man, a socialite, a rag robe ascetic, or a Dhamma preacher

examples.text: yathā taṃ yuvā yuvatin'ti daharo dahariṃ, taruṇo taruṇiṃ, kāmabhogī kāmabhoginiṃ.
diṭṭhiñ'ca nissāya anupucchamāno, samuggahītesu pamoham'āgā, ito ca n'āddakkhi aṇum'pi saññaṃ, tasmā tuvaṃ momuhato dahāsi.
yen'eva bālo'ti paraṃ dahāti, ten'ātumānaṃ kusalo'ti c'āha, sayam'attanā so kusalo vadāno, aññaṃ vimāneti tadeva pāva.

32197.commentary: (VINa) dahati vā dahāpeti vā'ti antamaso pattam'pi pacanto sayaṃ vā dahati, aññena vā dahāpeti. yattakesu ṭhānesu aggiṃ deti vā dāpeti vā tattakāni pācittiyāni.
